title: The Coming Muharram - Take Precaution in the Month of Muharram
body:
It was Hajj al-Akbar this year, but they (awliyaullah) delayed it by one day because there were saints on
Arafat this year and they did not like the general public to be there this year. The first of Muharram will be on
Saturday (November 26). This month Dhul Hijjah is 29 days, meaning Saturday is more correct.
Allah (swt) knows what will take place and what will happen during the month of Muharram; therefore, if
there is no urgency or absolute necessity, there is no need to travel, not to America, not to Europe. You have
to take precaution and be careful and attentive.
Maybe WWIII will start in the Middle East and the Russian army may reach to the plain of Amuq in Syria.
The war will take place. Allah (swt) will make Islam victorious and support it and open the way to Turkey.
Allah (swt) may open the way to Istanbul. From there, the sultan will come and enter Istanbul, and Imam
Mahdi (a) is still present in the movement, but he is not appearing yet.
Maybe this event will take place in the month of Rajab or after, when Imam Mahdi (a) will enter Istanbul.
This means that the region of the Middle East is on fire. The army will come from Damascus against the
Russian army and the hand of Imam Mahdi (a) is with the army, but he himself is not present or appearing.

I am not afraid, but rather cautious of the occurence of Armageddon as the time is very near! Therefore, in
the month of Muharram everyone must be careful and take precaution. They should not move like this, like
that. Without absolute necessity, do not move! Everyone must remain in their areas and in their homes (stay
where they are). Odhkhuloo masaakinakum, “Get into your dwellings!”
••••••• •••••••• ••• •••••••• ••••••••• ••••••••• ••••••••••••• ••• ••••••••••••••• ••••••••••• ••••••••••• •••••• •••
•••••••••••
Qaalat namlatun yaa ayyuha 'n-namlu 'dkhuloo masaakinakum laa yahtimannakum Sulaymaanu wa
junooduhoo wa hum la yash`uroon.
One of the ants said, "O Ants! Enter your homes unless Sulayman and his armies unknowingly trample you.
(an-Naml, 27:18)
It means do not go out of your homes unless absolutely necessary. Keep yourselves in your homes as the one
who stays in his or her home is in safety and security, but he who goes out is in danger as something may hit
him.
Therefore, every person according to their situation and possibility, should keep stocks (of food) in their
homes so they may not be needy. And you do not know, the grocery shops may be closed and you may not
find anything. You may then find something in your house, and from what you stocked for you and your
family for twenty days by divine permission and blessing may last forty days. If a person may buy extra, more
than his family’s needs, and he asks to grant to the poor people who come and knock at his door, he may also
reach them. By the divine generosity of Allah (swt) and by His favor and blessing, if you spend something on
the poor servants of Allah (swt) He will increase the provision in your home without you knowing it. Do you
understand?
Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem... (du`a). May what we ate and drank give power to our bodies, light to our
hearts and cure to our chests for the honor of the Prophet (s), his Companions (r), our shaykhs, Um Hiram,
Hajjah Amina (q) and those who are following, and the believers.
Fatihah.

(Are these instructions for everyone?) Yes, of course they are for everybody, for the general public and
especially for those who are in the Middle East.
The time of Saahib uz-Zamaan has just arrived. There is no need to move outside the country. If it is possible,
they should keep themselves. If anything happens come to your homes, make wudu, pray two raka`ats and
then sit there: nothing will touch you. Alhamdulillah, barakat.
(When is this?) The whole month of Muharram, everywhere will be turned upside down!
Lefke, 16.11.2011 ((Translated from Arabic)
